summary: Phase 1 Email Automation Foundation independently verified end-to-end on both platforms. Backend API contract: 10/10 pytest PASS (signup consent true/false/omitted, prefs GET/POST + bogus token 400, unsubscribe GET scanner-safe + POST one-click, authenticated GET/PATCH /api/account/marketing-preferences, Resend webhook inert 503, can_send_marketing central gate blocking no-consent/suppressed). Web UI: MarketingEmailToggle at /settings/digest renders, toggling fires PATCH /api/account/marketing-preferences (200), state persists across reload. Mobile UI: MarketingEmailCard on Settings tab renders with correct testIDs, toggling fires PATCH 200. All test-created @example.com users + their marketing_consent_events + email_suppressions cleaned up; cathy@example.com restored to marketing_consent=false with no residual suppression. RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET was never set.
critical_code_review_comments: NOTE (not a defect): Mobile MarketingEmailCard uses React Native Switch whose `value` prop does not render as `aria-checked` in the Expo web preview DOM, so automated UI assertions must verify state via the backend API after the PATCH (which we did). This does not affect real devices.

Suggestion: consider adding `accessibilityState={{checked: value}}` to the mobile Switch so Playwright/axe tooling can read its state as aria-checked in the web preview — strictly a QA/A11Y nicety, not a bug.
test_credentials: cathy@example.com / testpass123 (caregiver, active) — used for authenticated settings toggle tests on both platforms.
seed_data_creation: 7 synthetic TEST_phase1_*@example.com signup users were created purely by the pytest and deleted (+ their marketing_consent_events and email_suppressions) by the test's own autouse cleanup fixture. No seed scripts run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 (email automation foundation) is green. New pytest regression file /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_api_contract_iter395.py exercises the full API contract and hits a Redis guard — it self-resets the signup rate-limit bucket before each signup call so it can run back-to-back. Mobile Switch state verification needs backend confirmation (no aria-checked attribute on Expo web). Resend webhook correctly 503s while RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset — do NOT set it in preview.
